claim: On the Next core the /INT pulse outlasts a 128K's 36 T, so a handler that enables interrupts soon after the acknowledge is entered twice; this shows only on the board, not in emulators.

evidence.text: Measured on the board with a test handler: at 128K timing it re-enters when sampled 38 T after the acknowledge, not at 42 (48K timing: 34 yes, 38 no); unfixed builds crashed at about 8 s.
